contract.action: Parse through parse5, serialize its repaired tree, and materialize the canonical HTML in LinkeDOM.
contract.baseline: The rejected happy-dom adapter uses one isolated Window and DOMParser per operation.
contract.correctness: Element count and sentinel text survive, valid input has no parse5 errors, and source scripts do not execute.
contract.noiseRule: Fresh process per cohort; pass every frozen p95, peak-RSS-delta, and retained-heap budget.
contract.proposed: platejs/html/server owns parse5 repair plus a LinkeDOM DOM facade.
contract.repeatedUnit: One parse5 node and one LinkeDOM node per source element.
contract.userOperation: Detached HTML document or ContentSlice parsing in Node.
